_note: How much research each run does. Research runs every 15 minutes and starts as many researchers as the queue needs, up to sweep.researchers (the cap on usage); an empty queue starts none. gap_workers searchers run on every other run. The backlog desk only acts when more than backlog.leave_for_sweep stories are waiting. The editor job may move these by at most a quarter a week; the owner can set them to anything.
